t.zh: 全称 ∀ 读作「对所有」：∀x. P(x) 说的是，世上每一样东西 x 都满足 P。
t.en: The universal ∀ reads “for all”: ∀x. P(x) says every thing x in the world satisfies P.

t.zh: 先把一句话拼成公式；拼错时，检查器可能给出一个小世界：在那里，你拼的公式和目标真假不同。之后，别人也译了这句话，轮到你用一个世界说明他译错了。
t.en: First build a sentence as a formula; when it is wrong, the checker may show a small world where it and the target differ. Then someone else has translated the sentence too, and it is your turn to show with a world that they got it wrong.

after.zh: 一句话永远成立，是说它在所有世界里都真；世界有无穷多个，大小不限。
after.en: A sentence that always holds is true in every world, and there are infinitely many worlds, of any size.

brief.zh: 用下面的元件，把这句话拼成公式。
brief.en: Build this sentence as a formula from the parts below.

hint.zh: 「人都会死」：对每一样东西 x，如果 x 是人，那么 x 会死。
hint.en: “Every human is mortal”: for every thing x, if x is human then x is mortal.

hint.zh: 写成「x 是人 ∧ x 会死」，说的是世上每一样东西都是人。
hint.en: Writing “x is human ∧ x is mortal” says every thing in the world is human.

brief.zh: 上一段你把这句话拼成了公式；这是别人拼的。造一个世界，让两份译文真假不同。
brief.en: You built this sentence as a formula; this is someone else’s. Build a world where the two differ in truth.

hint.zh: 点一样东西，它就「是人」；再点一下，就不是。
hint.en: Tap a thing to make it human; tap again to undo.

hint.zh: 这份译文说每样东西都怎样？世界里有一样不是人的东西呢？
hint.en: What does this translation say of every thing? What if the world holds a thing that is not human?

t.zh: 命题逻辑里，一句话的真假看真值表的哪一行。一阶逻辑里，看的是<wiki-ref to="world"></wiki-ref>：世界里有几样东西，每样东西是什么、和别的东西是什么关系。
t.en: In propositional logic, whether a sentence is true depends on the row of the truth table. In first-order logic it depends on the <wiki-ref to="world"></wiki-ref>: how many things there are, what each is and how they relate.

t.zh: 上方是你的译文，和别人的译文。要说明别人的错了，就造一个世界，让两份译文一真一假：在下面选好有几样东西，再点出每样东西有哪些性质。运行时，上方标出两份译文在这个世界里的真假。
t.en: Above are your translation and someone else’s. To show theirs is wrong, build a world where the two differ: choose below how many things there are, then tap what holds of each. A run marks above whether each translation is true in this world.

brief.zh: 上一段你把这句话拼成了公式；这是别人拼的。造一个世界，让两份译文真假不同。
brief.en: You built this sentence as a formula; this is someone else’s. Build a world where the two differ in truth.

hint.en: A human who is not mortal.
